assertion_analysis.would_fail_if: The input fixture header ceased to be version 2; no implementation regression alone reddens this file-content check.
read_trace returned the wrong grid shape or shifted the first raw psi sample; other grid positions are unchecked against the Fortran file.
write_trace emitted a header other than version 2.
write_trace omitted or changed slice, iteration, verdict, axis or polarity while read_trace stayed fixed; a matching reader error could leave the round trip green.
write_trace corrupted any listed array while read_trace stayed fixed; coordinated row-order mistakes in both implementations survive.
read_trace accepted a version-1 header or raised the wrong exception.
grid_for or write_state emitted a grid other than 65 by 65 or a polygon with fewer than three vertices.
read_trace decoded a different boundary value or verdict from the receipt, but a wrong field or decision copied to both record and receipt leaves these assertions true.
root_census returned zero or more than one in-vessel stationary root on this fixture.
root_census returned a root outside the same geometry predicate the test calls; a defect shared with that predicate survives.
write_trace changed exported psi or wall polygon while read_trace stayed fixed; matching reader/writer mistakes or a wrong source field remain green.
configure_dtypes stopped enabling JAX binary64 before either measurement or export.

findings.text: follow-on: SplineField duplicates the fit and value-gradient-Hessian capability of nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:264-348 instead of wrapping that owner, leaving two implementations of the same spline field.

follow-on: the round-trip array assertion compares a record read by read_trace with a second read after write_trace receives that record, so matching row-order mistakes in both functions survive; only the first grid sample has an independent raw-file check at line 23.

follow-on: the export receipt's boundary level and label at lines 76-77 are copied from the same BoundaryTrace fields in export.py:83-86, so a wrong sampled field or decision can move both sides together without reddening the test.
follow-on: the focused gate reads one selected export and no case table, so deleting another export or changing the 26-case comparison leaves its four tests green despite the done-when count.

item_verdicts.diff: commit eba50093741297e5781ddc20719c1979fba2f9c8 against 80ee84b289d41d5a1bfbda8c3a5b94a7b2d7f1cd adds nine files and 1317 lines, including the trace reader, spline adapter, exporter, tests and case table.
item_verdicts.done_when: prompt.txt:97-104 requires the reader, adapter, 26 case decisions, 18 exports and a table; gate-head.log records four passing tests, while exports/measurements_final and exports/receipts.json carry the full counts outside that gate.
item_verdicts.goal: prompt.txt:30 asks for nova reads, reciprocal fields and one disagreement table; docs/research/efit-field-swap.html:33-35 supplies the table and export.py:125-144 writes tie states, with the imas-efit handoff assigned to the coordinator.
item_verdicts.manifest: manifest.md records one commit, nine changed paths, base collection failure, head four-test pass, 26 qualified reads and 18 exports, corroborated by gate-base.log, gate-head.log and exports/receipts.json.
item_verdicts.write_paths: prompt.txt:70-74 grants the prototype directory, research page, figure directory and evidence fragment; all nine paths in commit eba50093741297e5781ddc20719c1979fba2f9c8 stay inside them.

justifications.durability: test_trace.py:56-60 would redden if unsupported versions were accepted and test_trace.py:104 would redden if this trace gained an in-wall root, but test_trace.py:76-77 compares export values to receipts copied from those same values and the gate never checks all cases.
justifications.evidence: gate-head.log records four passing tests from test_trace.py, while the 26 case rows and 18 export count in docs/research/efit-field-swap.html:22 and exports/receipts.json are artifact measurements rather than assertions in that gate.
justifications.fit: adapter.py:230-241 hands its field, geometry and roots to the existing fast read, and the added source names describe their capability without plan-stage labels.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/research/efit-field-swap.html:22 records all 26 cross-reads and export.py:125-144 emits the reciprocal tie fields the source goal requested.
justifications.reuse: adapter.py:20-68 fits and evaluates a not-a-knot tensor cubic spline already owned by nova/linalg/tensor_spline.py:264-348; the search also found no existing boundary-trace reader in nova, scripts, tests or benchmarks.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path added by commit eba50093741297e5781ddc20719c1979fba2f9c8 falls under the four grants in prompt.txt:70-74 and serves the exchange or its evidence.
